subject.title: Anaheim Union High School District Board, Trustee Area 1

text: Governing Board Member, Anaheim Union High School District, Trustee Area 1
I am a lifelong Anaheim resident, graduate of Anaheim public schools, daughter of an AUHSD classified employee, and proud to serve as your Trustee.
Together, we have strengthened our schools, expanded opportunities for students, and built a brighter future for every child in AUHSD.

We strengthened Career Technical Education pathways, implemented the district's first-ever agreement to reduce class sizes, expanded student resources, including laundry services for students in need, opened school-based mental health and wellness centers, and launched the Parent Ambassador Program to strengthen family engagement.
None of this progress would have been possible without the dedication of our teachers, classified employees, staff, parents, families, and community partners.

I am committed to continuing this work by strengthening partnerships that support the whole child, ensuring every student feels safe, supported, and seen, and expanding 21st-century learning opportunities that prepare students for today's workforce and tomorrow's opportunities.

My career has been dedicated to education. I graduated from CSU Fullerton and UC Irvine and now serve as a Senior Policy Advisor for the County of Orange, connecting children and families with educational resources.
I am proud to be From Our Schools, For Our Schools.
Visit www.voteguerrero.com to learn more.

text: Parent

As a current AUHSD parent, bold voice, and dedicated educational advocate, I am running for Anaheim Union High School District Trustee, Area 1, to ensure every student has the opportunity to succeed in a safe, supportive, and high-quality learning environment.

I am a proud graduate of Sycamore Junior High School and Anaheim High School. My older children proudly graduated from AUHSD, and today I am the parent of three current Anaheim High School students. As both a graduate and parent, I understand the hopes and challenges of Anaheim families because I have experienced them firsthand.

For 23 years, I proudly served Anaheim families in supportive roles, including as a Community Liaison with the Anaheim Elementary School District, helping students and parents access the resources they needed to thrive. I have been actively engaged as a civic community leader in Anaheim for many years and am an established advocate for students and families.
I proudly stand with teachers, parents, students, and our community because strong schools begin with supporting those who educate our children.

As your Trustee, I will champion student safety, quality educational opportunities, transparency, accountability, and meaningful parent engagement. I am not afraid to ask the tough questions or hold our district accountable.
I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Mother/Businesswoman
It’s time to put students first for a change.

I'm running for the Anaheim Union High School District Board because every student deserves a champion who will stand up for our classrooms, support our teachers, and make decisions based on what's best for our community.

As a parent and longtime Anaheim resident, I've spent nearly two decades supporting our local schools. My husband Khoi and I proudly raised our son through the Spanish Dual Immersion pathway at Benito Juarez Elementary, Sycamore Junior High, and Anaheim High School because we believe in the promise of public education.

I've served in PTA leadership, booster organizations, and district committees, always working alongside parents, teachers, and school staff to strengthen our schools. When the AUHSD School Board voted to eliminate more than 250 teaching positions in 2024, I stood with parents, teachers, students, and our community to protect classroom resources because I believe we deserve better.

I also bring the financial experience needed to responsibly oversee a multi-million-dollar school district. I hold a Master of Business Administration and have extensive experience in budgeting, financial oversight, public contracting, and accountability. I know we can make responsible financial decisions without losing sight of what matters most: our students.
Every Student. Every Classroom. Every Day.
www.Germaine4Education.com
